title: The Crossover Ashoka®
subtitle: Two rows crossing at the center — drawn as one ring, never two.

stone.origin: Natural. Upper row set east-west, lower row north-south on a waved band. [NOTE: exact carat weights not available — confirm before going live.]

description: The Crossover Ashoka® by Bez Ambar — a two-row ring designed as one piece rather than two stackable bands. The upper row of elongated Ashoka-style step-cuts runs east-west; the lower row runs north-south on a waved shank, so the crossover holds at the center. Available in 18-karat yellow or white gold. Ref BA-CR-001.
